description: This file implements the PersistentStoreImplementation class, which manages a persistent storage component using a SQLite backend. It handles registration, initialization, and cleanup of store interfaces within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: PersistentStoreImplementation
classes.description: A class that manages persistent storage using SQLite, providing registration, interface querying, and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: PersistentStoreImplementation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the store, registers sink, and queries interfaces.

methods.name: ~PersistentStoreImplementation
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters sink, releases interfaces, and cleans up resources.
